name: agent definition
wording: An agent as a harness receives it: its profile projected into the harness's own file for an agent, which the harness discovers to launch or dispatch it.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in. Named agent definition, the established term, in place of agent declaration.
